transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose it's just that my head feels a bit foggy lately. I keep mixing up simple things. Like... appointment times, dates for the exhibits, or which of the volunteers I've already called. It's just... hard to keep it all straight.
How long have you been feeling this foggy sensation in your head?
I suppose... about four months now. Ever since the water damage happened and we had to start remodeling. It's just been since then.
Have you noticed any difficulty remembering things that happened before the water damage and remodeling started?
No... I don't believe so. Things from before all that seem clear enough. It's really just... the newer things. The day-to-day.
Do you ever feel unsure about where you are or what time of day it is?
No... I don't think so. I know where I am. It's just... the other things I mentioned.
Do you ever feel confused about who you are?
No... I know who I am. It's nothing like that. Just... what I said before.
Do you ever feel disoriented or uncertain about your surroundings?
No... I know my way around fine. I don't get lost or anything like that.
Have you had trouble learning new things since you started feeling foggy?
I haven't really... tried to learn anything new lately. So I wouldn't know.
Do you have trouble focusing or paying attention to things?

I suppose... yes. That's really what brought me in. My head just feels... foggy. I keep mixing up simple things. Appointment times... exhibit dates. Even forgetting which volunteer I already called. Just... having trouble keeping it all straight.
Have you had trouble remembering things that happened recently, like what you did yesterday or last week?
Not really... I remember yesterday fine. It's mostly just... what I said a minute ago. Just mixing things up.
Do you ever find yourself struggling to find the right words when you're talking?
I don't think so... no. I mean, I can usually find the words I want. It's just... holding onto the thought long enough to say it.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep since you started feeling foggy?
No... I don't think so. I sleep about the same as I always do.
Do you have trouble making decisions or planning things out?
I don't think so. I just... do what needs doing. There isn't really much to plan anyway.
Do you have trouble speaking in complete sentences?
No... my sentences are fine. I just talk normally, I suppose.
Do you have trouble organizing tasks or activities?
Not really. I just take things as they come. There's not much to organize at my age.
Do you often search for the right word when trying to express yourself?
I don't believe so. I usually... just know what I want to say.
Do you have trouble recalling specific words or names when you want to use them?
No, I don't think so. The words come to me fine.
Do you have trouble with tasks that require planning or problem-solving?
I don't think so. I... well, my days are pretty simple now. There isn't much to plan.
Do you have trouble staying focused on a single task for a long period of time?

I suppose so. Mostly, it's just... my head feels foggy lately. I think that's really what brought me in. I just keep mixing up simple things. Like... appointment times, or exhibit dates. I'll forget which volunteer I already called. I just... can't seem to keep it all straight.
Do you have trouble recalling things that happened earlier today?
No... not really. I remember what I did this morning just fine.
Do you have trouble remembering what you talked about with someone after the conversation is over?
No, I don't think so. I can usually remember what was said.
